name: Berlinische Galerie
known: Founded in 1975 as a society devoted to exhibiting Berlin art, with the art historian Eberhard Roters as founding director.
Thomas Köhler has been director since September 2010.
Its foundation council is chaired by Dr.

Alexander Steinhilber, head of the culture division of the Senate Department for Culture and Social Cohesion; members include Jens-Rainer Jänig, chair of the Förderverein, Hilke Wagner of the Albertinum Dresden, Uli Mayer-Johanssen and Thomas Jebsen of DKB-Immobilien GmbH (stated by the museum).
